name: vllm-rocm-r9700-main
description: vLLM runtime image for AMD Radeon AI PRO R9700/gfx1201 assembled from vllm-rocm-r9700-main-wheel. Uses the same daily pytorch-rocm-r9700 base as the wheel builder to keep Python/ABI aligned, filters wheel constraints to ROCm/PyTorch ABI pins, then installs the prebuilt wheel and validates torch/vLLM import.
